about: A reader is what it emits over its vectors: its identity is measured again when any file the bundler takes of it moves, its module or a helper a step above it, and it stays the reader it was when what it emits did not move.
What keys the measure is the bundle's inputs at their stamps, as the bundler read them: never the files that merely lie beside the module.

cases.name: a helper a directory above the module changes what it emits
a helper changes and the reader emits the same over its vectors
cases.identity: the one it was, memos kept

cases.name: a file beside the module that the module never imports moves

red was: a reader's identity digested the files beside its module, so a helper a directory up that changed what it emitted served the old answers under the old identity
